title: Earn is on the way
description: A short look at the Earn tab in XRP Mobile. There is no yield product yet: the tab shows what we are building towards, self custody yield with no lock ups, and the two pools we would start from, XRP and RLUSD. Nothing is confirmed and no rate is promised. Turn on the notification to hear about it first.
lede: There is an Earn tab in XRP Mobile, and right now it earns you nothing. Here is why that is deliberate.

steps.caption: Open Earn
steps.body: Tap Earn. No rate, no launch date, no fine print, because there is no product yet.

steps.caption: What we are aiming for
steps.body: Instead it says what we are building towards: XRP that works while it sits, keys that never leave your phone, and no lock ups.

steps.caption: Where we would start
steps.body: And where we would start: XRP first, then RLUSD for balances you would rather keep in dollars. Nothing confirmed, no rate promised.

steps.caption: Get told when it lands
steps.body: If you want to know the day it goes live, turn on the notification and forget about it.
